Gaseous ammonia reacts with an excess of gaseous hydrogen chloride in a sealed flask.
NH3(g)+HCl(g)→NH4Cl(s)
The reaction is exothermic.
Which statements about the reaction are correct?
1
The number of gas particles in the flask decreases.
2
The average kinetic energy of the gas particles increases.
3
The activation energy of the reaction increases.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
